name: Ford
description: Ford over a generic OBD-II dongle (HS-CAN, UDS). Tuned for the Ranger T6 (P375) 3.2 Duratorq diesel with the 6R80 auto, using the decrypted IDS 133.01 MDX DID tables. Reads modules on the HS-CAN bus only -- body modules on MS-CAN need a switchable adapter.

panel.title: All modules (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Module scan for CAN-era Fords (≈2008+) over the ordinary OBD dongle — each HS-CAN module's own fault memory, deeper than generic OBD-II. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan. Body modules on MS-CAN need a switchable adapter — they won't show here.
panel.scanBusy: Walking the HS-CAN modules through the dongle… (absent addresses time out quietly)

actions.busy: Asking the PCM for the IDS-table values…
actions.title: Ford live extras
actions.hint: Reads the Ranger 3.2 PCM values from Ford's own IDS tables — rail pressure control, soot load, injector and EGR adjustments — raw hex kept beside every decode.
